2. Apprehending his arrest, the applicant has approached this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail, in connection with Panki P.S. Case No.116 of 2022, registered for the offence under Section 409, 420 & 468 of the Indian Penal Code, Section 7 of the Essential Commodities Act,
pending in the court of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate, Palamau.
3. Innocence of the applicant has been claimed and undertaking has been given for co-operating with the investigating agency and participation in the trial.
It has been submitted that the applicant is a P.D.S. shop owner.
As per the allegation, there was some discrepancies and his licence has also been suspended.
The criminal case has also been lodged.
On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.
4. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.

5. Considering the nature of allegations and the materials available on record, I am inclined to grant Ajay Kumar Singh vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... ... on 16 January, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/153820862/

Accordingly, the applicant is directed to surrender in the court below within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrender, the court below shall enlarge the applicant on bail on his furnishing bail bond of Rs.10,000/- (Ten Thousand)
with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Chief Judicial Magistrate,
Palamau, in connection with Panki P.S. Case No.116 of 2022, subject to the condition as laid down under Section 438 (2) Cr.P.C.

Further, the applicant will submit self-attested photocopy of his Aadhaar Card and also submit his mobile number before the learned court below which he will always keep active and will not change it during pendency of this case without prior permission of the court.
